question: In January 2023, who was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Bihar for the ninth time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitish Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Nitish Kumar was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Bihar for the ninth time in January 2023.
 
• He has been serving as the Chief Minister of Bihar since 2005, with brief interruptions.
 
• Nitish Kumar is the leader of the Janata Dal (United) party and has formed alliances with various parties over the years to maintain his position.
 
• His tenure has been marked by efforts to improve infrastructure, education, and governance in Bihar.
 
• He is known for switching alliances between the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) in his political career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Janata Dal (United) Party:**

 
 
• A regional political party primarily based in Bihar.
 
• Founded in 1999 by merging various factions of the Janata Dal.
 
• The party's ideology focuses on socialism, secularism, and promoting the welfare of the marginalized sections of society.
 
 
 
• **Political Career of Nitish Kumar:**
 
 
• Nitish Kumar has held various positions in the Indian government, including Union Minister for Railways and Agriculture.
 
• He is recognized for implementing reforms in the railways during his tenure as Union Minister.
 
• He became Chief Minister of Bihar for the first time in 2000 but resigned within seven days due to lack of majority.
 
 
 
• **Political Alliances in Bihar:**
 
 
• Bihar's political landscape often involves coalition governments, with alliances shifting frequently.
 
• Nitish Kumar has historically aligned with both BJP and RJD based on political circumstances.
 
• His coalition with RJD in 2022 marked a significant shift from his earlier alliance with BJP.
 
 
 
• **Governance Initiatives:**
 
 
• Nitish Kumar's tenure as Chief Minister has focused on enhancing infrastructure, including road connectivity and electricity supply.
 
• He has launched programs to improve education, such as bicycle distribution for schoolgirls and scholarships.
 
• Efforts have also been made to curb corruption and increase transparency in governance.
